_help.coordinates: All positions are tile coordinates [x, y], with [0, 0] at the top-left.
_help.paths: Each path is a list of corner points, from where enemies enter (on the map edge) to the base. Segments must be straight horizontal or vertical lines. Enemies are spread across all paths.
_help.base: The cottage enemies are trying to reach; every path must end here.
_help.obstacles: Hand-placed things you can't plant on: pond (x, y, w, h), tree (x, y), rock (x, y).
_help.waveSize: Multiplies how many enemies come per wave on this map (maps with short roads or several entrances can use less than 1).
_help.startCoins: Multiplies the starting coins on this map (maps with several entrances need more flowers early).
_help.scatter: Extra trees and rocks placed randomly (but the same every game) on free tiles; change seed for a different layout.
